notes: «- قال فلقيت ابن المطوس فحدثني -» is an editor/narrator gloss between dashes: left out
«مثل حديث ابن كثير وسليمان» is part of the saying, abridged by reference to other reports, not a route
Abu Dawud's remark «واختلف على سفيان وشعبة عنهما ابن المطوس وأبو المطوس» names an alternative for the level after عمارة: noted, not stored as a route, since the text does not write that variant out
